Nice-to-haves: padded gloves, a water bottle + cage, and a small saddle bag to carry the basics.

For your very first ride, keep it simple and do a quick pre-ride check: make sure your tires are pumped, your brakes work, your chain looks/feels okay, and all the key bolts feel snug.
Good news: our bikes are almost all pro-built—there’s usually just a few final pieces to put together, and that typically takes about 10–20 minutes.
